title: Hang gliding: from first flight to instructor
intro: Start with your first flights at a BHPA school, then work up the pilot ratings and add launch methods. From there you can fly passengers, coach, teach or fly competitions. Every step is here in order.

sections.title: Coaching and teaching track
sections.intro: Club Coach needs Club Pilot (step 2) plus 10 hours on the hill or 50 tow flights. The other coach awards need the Pilot rating (step 3). Instructor training needs the Pilot rating plus 25 launches.
